headline: Mold-Tek Packaging shares rise 8% after Q2 results
hook: Intraday high hit following Q2 numbers
summary: Mold-Tek Packaging shares climbed 8% to an intraday high of Rs 320 on the NSE following its Q2 results for fiscal 2026. The stock opened at Rs 299.90, up from its previous close of Rs 292.50. Retail investors tracking small-cap packaging counters should note the increased price volatility and volume following earnings announcements. Market participants are watching the price action for further momentum.
why_it_matters: Short-term volatility rises for Mold-Tek Packaging holders.

headline: Mold-Tek Packaging shares surge 17% on 35% jump in Q2 profit
hook: Strongest quarter yet for Mold-Tek Packaging
summary: Mold-Tek Packaging reported a 35.5% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 21 crore for Q2 FY27, alongside a 30.5% growth in revenue. Strong packaging volumes from the pharmaceutical and fast-moving consumer goods sectors drove the performance. The company also pointed to new product launches and expansion plans supporting its medium-term growth outlook. Retail shareholders in the packaging sector benefit from confirmed volume recovery in key consumer segments.
why_it_matters: Stronger margins and FMCG demand lift packaging stock valuations.
winners_losers: Mold-Tek Packaging shareholders gain / competitors face margin pressure
